name: The Anointing
overview: The Anointing in Scripture signifies God's chosen empowerment and blessing, as seen when oil is poured upon a person's head to set them apart for His purposes, such as in Exodus 29:7. David is a prime example of one anointed with God's holy oil, marking him as the LORD’s servant and shepherd over His people (Psalms 23:1; Psalms 89:20). The anointing also involves the Spirit of the Lord enabling ministry and healing, as Isaiah 61:1 describes the Lord’s anointing to preach and bring liberty, and Mark 6:13 shows anointing used in healing the sick. Furthermore, Joel 2:28 promises a future outpouring of the Spirit, extending anointing beyond individuals to all believers who will prophesy and receive visions.
